newsitem.title: HONG KONG: United Airlines cargo to open new freight service.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines cargo to open new freight service.

text.p: United Airlines Worldwide Cargo would launch a new international freighter service linking the United States and Asia on March 3, United Airlines said in a statement on Friday.
It would operate two DC-10-30F aircraft to carry cargo only between Chicago and Los Angeles through Anchorage, Alaska, and the Pacific Rim markets of Osaka, Taipei and Manila.
From fall of 1997, two additional aircraft will join the fleet, expanding service to New York, San Francisco and Tokyo.
The service would operate six days a week, it said.
